topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Found a hidden room, huh? Figures. You think you're the first one to stumble onto a surprise in a place like this? Bet it's got dust thick enough to write your name in. First rule of the job—start with the assumption everyone's lying, or at least not telling the whole truth. But this, this is the kind of detail that can tip the scales, the kind of find that turns a job from a run-of-the-mill investigation into something with a little more... substance. You don't get rooms like that without a good reason, and I plan to find out every last detail of what that reason might be. Got a hunch this could lead somewhere interesting.
